pr.title: deslop(cake_moe_grouped_gemm, experimental): import the core helpers behind an ImportError guard, add the standalone-import test
pr.body:
## Summary

This PR resolves #7047. `cake_moe_grouped_gemm` imported `flashinfer_experimental_api` and `warn_experimental_backend_once` from `...api_logging` at module level. It also imported `register_custom_op` / `register_fake_op` from `...utils`. As a result, a copy of the package failed to import when loaded on its own, either under another import path or with FlashInfer absent or blocked. The two `api_logging` helpers are now imported in one new module, `_experimental.py`, inside an `ImportError` guard. If that import fails, the module uses package-local stand-ins. The two `utils` decorators are removed. They were identity no-ops, so no custom op was ever registered. A new CPU-only test imports a copy of the package with `flashinfer` blocked. The change touches only Python and the README.

Behaviour:
- **In-tree: no observable change.** `flashinfer/experimental/__init__.py` imports `api_logging` before any subpackage body runs. So the package binds FlashInfer's own decorator and backend-warning function. The `ExperimentalWarning` class, the once-only flags, the API logging and the `is_experimental` attributes are all the same as before. `scripts/list_apis.sh --experimental` still lists the package's four functions, because the decorator name is unchanged. There are only two deltas. `sys.modules` gains the `_experimental` module. The private `_OP_PREFIX` and `_*_fake` names are gone, and nothing called them.
- **Standalone: three differences.** These apply when FlashInfer is absent, when `sys.modules["flashinfer"] = None`, or when the installed FlashInfer lacks these helpers.
  1. The warning category is the package's own `ExperimentalWarning`, which is a `UserWarning`. A filter on `flashinfer.experimental.ExperimentalWarning` does not match it.
  2. There is no API logging and no tensor dump. `FLASHINFER_LOGLEVEL` is not read.
  3. The once-per-(api, backend) set is package-local.
- **Residual coupling.** The guard runs at package import and tolerates `ImportError` only. A copy loaded next to an importable FlashInfer binds that installation's helpers and imports `flashinfer` at package import. Two things would then break the copy's import: an error other than `ImportError` from that FlashInfer's own initialisation, or a changed signature of its `flashinfer_experimental_api`. Under the vendoring gate (`python -I` with `sys.modules["flashinfer"] = None`), the stand-ins are bound and the package loads.
- **Autograd: unchanged.** The removed decorators were identity no-ops. Nothing was registered with torch.library before this change either.

## Changes

Base: upstream main `39f9462f7` (2026-10-23). Head: `d217375db`. The PR is one commit: `cake_moe_grouped_gemm: import core helpers behind an ImportError guard`. 6 files, +624 / -46.

Package paths below are relative to `flashinfer/experimental/cake_moe_grouped_gemm/`.

### `_experimental.py` (new, +155)

- `_core_helpers()` tries `from flashinfer.api_logging import flashinfer_experimental_api, warn_experimental_backend_once` inside `try/except ImportError`. It runs once, at package import.
- On success, the package binds FlashInfer's own objects and sets `STANDALONE = False`.
- On `ImportError`, it binds package-local stand-ins and sets `STANDALONE = True`:
  - `_standalone_experimental_api`: a decorator with the same docstring banner, the same `is_experimental` / `experimental_feature` attributes and the same warning text. It warns once per function, with `stacklevel=2`.
  - `_standalone_warn_backend_once(api_name, backend, *, automatic=False)`: the same text, with `stacklevel=3`. It warns once per (api, backend) pair and records the pairs in a package-local set, `_WARNED_BACKENDS`.
  - A package-local `ExperimentalWarning(UserWarning)` class.

### `__init__.py` and `cake_backend.py` (+1 / -1 each)

- `__init__.py` now imports `flashinfer_experimental_api` from `._experimental` instead of `...api_logging`. The three decorated public functions keep byte-identical signatures, `feature=` strings and docstrings.
- `cake_backend.py` now imports `warn_experimental_backend_once` from `._experimental` instead of `...api_logging`. The call `warn_experimental_backend_once("grouped_mm_bf16", "cake")` in `grouped_mm_bf16_cake` is unchanged.

### `cake_autograd.py` (+4 / -35)

- The imports `from ...api_logging import flashinfer_experimental_api` and `from ...utils import register_custom_op, register_fake_op` are removed.
- `_OP_PREFIX`, the three `@register_custom_op(...)` decorators and the three `@register_fake_op` fake implementations (`_fwd_fake`, `_dgrad_fake`, `_wgrad_fake`) are removed.
- This is safe because `register_custom_op` and `register_fake_op` are identity no-ops in both torch branches of `flashinfer/utils.py` (lines 409, 415, 438, 445). No torch.library op was ever registered. `CakeGroupedMm.forward` and `CakeGroupedMm.backward` call the plain functions as before.
- The header comment (lines 17-21) claimed a registration. It is corrected.
- `_fwd_op`, `_dgrad_op`, `_wgrad_op`, `_bf16_rows`, `CakeGroupedMm` and `cake_grouped_mm` are byte-identical.

### `README.md` (+33 / -9)

- The incorrect "custom op" sentence is replaced.
- The stable-API paragraph now says the warning is FlashInfer's `ExperimentalWarning`. It adds that a copy running without FlashInfer warns with the package's own class when `cake_backend.grouped_mm_bf16_cake` is called directly.
- A new section, "Standalone import", states the three differences and the residual coupling.
- The pytest command line lists the new test file.

### `tests/experimental/test_cake_moe_grouped_gemm_standalone.py` (new, +430)

The file is CPU-only (`CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=""`). It calls `pytest.importorskip("tvm_ffi")` because `cake_backend` imports `tvm_ffi` at module level. The existing API suite does the same. It has four tests:

- `test_vendored_copy_imports_and_warns_with_flashinfer_blocked`:
  - It copies the package into a temporary directory under a neutral top-level name, leaving out `__pycache__`, `aot` and `csrc`.
  - A `python -I -c` subprocess (timeout 600 s) blocks `flashinfer` with the same two mechanisms as the repository's vendoring gate: a meta-path finder that raises `ImportError`, and `sys.modules["flashinfer"] = None`.
  - The subprocess imports the copy and resolves every `__all__` name.
  - It checks the once-only warnings: text, category name and attribution to the caller.
  - It checks the host-side `ValueError`s of fwd, dgrad, wgrad, `cake_grouped_mm` and `grouped_mm_bf16_cake`.
  - It checks that no `flashinfer` module was loaded. The test expects `OK` on stdout.
- `test_flashinfer_is_named_only_inside_two_importerror_guards`: it parses the package's `*.py` files with `ast` and checks three rules:
  - No relative import reaches above the package (`level < 2`).
  - Every `flashinfer` import sits inside a `try` with an `except ImportError` handler.
  - There are exactly two guard sites, one in `_experimental.py` and one in `cake_build.py`.
- `test_in_tree_binds_the_core_helpers`:
  - `STANDALONE is False`.
  - The bound helpers are `flashinfer.api_logging`'s objects, checked by identity.
  - Fresh wrappers warn once with `flashinfer.api_logging.ExperimentalWarning`.
  - The backend pair lands in `api_logging._WARNED_EXPERIMENTAL_BACKENDS`, and the package-local set stays empty.
- `test_stand_ins_match_the_core_helpers`: it decorates two throwaway functions with the core decorator and with the stand-in. It then checks that the two match on:
  - `__doc__`, the attributes, `inspect.signature` and the default feature;
  - the warning text and category name;
  - the `(filename, lineno)` attribution through one helper frame, for both stacklevels;
  - silence on the second call;
  - both dedup sets after `automatic=False` and `automatic=True`.

## Validation

Each row compares the base (upstream main `39f9462f7`) with this branch.

- The CPU row runs `tests/experimental/test_cake_moe_grouped_gemm_standalone.py` with CUDA hidden.
- The GPU rows use a GB300 (SM103, compute capability 10.3) and a B200 (SM100, compute capability 10.0).
  - On both trees, they run `tests/experimental/test_cake_moe_grouped_gemm.py` and `tests/experimental/test_cake_moe_grouped_gemm_api.py` in fresh JIT workspaces and compare outcomes per test id.
  - On this branch, they also run the standalone test.

Results:

- **CPU node, both trees.** `tests/experimental/test_cake_moe_grouped_gemm_standalone.py` with CUDA hidden on this branch: 4 collected, 4 passed, 0 skipped. `scripts/check_cake_build_manifests.py` (default mode) on both trees: 22 packages checked, 33 findings on each tree, byte-identical lists, none naming this package (all are pre-existing findings on main in two other packages). Import scan of the package: on this branch the only `flashinfer` imports are the guarded sites in `_experimental.py` (one) and `cake_build.py`, and none is at module level; on the base, the four module-level imports the issue lists are present. Import probe with CUDA hidden on both trees: every `__all__` name resolves, `__all__` is identical, and on this branch the bound helpers are `flashinfer.api_logging`'s objects. pre-commit on the six changed files: 11 passed, 5 skipped (hooks with no matching file), 0 failed; `pre-commit run --all-files`: 15 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed; no file was modified. `git diff --check` is clean, the changed-file set is exactly the six files, and the branch has one commit ending with its trailer.
- **GB300 (SM103, compute capability 10.3).** `tests/experimental/test_cake_moe_grouped_gemm.py`: 38 collected, 38 passed on both trees, with identical per-test outcomes. `tests/experimental/test_cake_moe_grouped_gemm_api.py`: 2 collected, 2 passed on both trees. Each tree built its 4 JIT libraries in a fresh workspace. The standalone test on this branch: 4 passed.
- - **B200 (SM100, compute capability 10.0).** `tests/experimental/test_cake_moe_grouped_gemm.py`: 38 collected, 38 passed on both trees, with identical per-test outcomes. `tests/experimental/test_cake_moe_grouped_gemm_api.py`: 2 collected, 2 passed on both trees. Each tree built its 4 JIT libraries in a fresh workspace. The standalone test on this branch: 4 passed.

## Not in this PR

- **`cake_stepfun_moe` and `cake_rubin_mla_nvfp4_decode`.** `cake_stepfun_moe` has the same `...api_logging` import (`__init__.py:41`). `cake_rubin_mla_nvfp4_decode` has a function-local `...attention` import in `cake_backend.py`. Both need the same kind of fix and are left as follow-ups.
- **The issue's `cake_lm_head_loss` row.** That row was about `_probe_cluster_capacity` importing `...cuda_utils`. The import was removed by #7007, which is on main.
- **The dense projection GEMM manifest.** The issue's minor note that this manifest has no sm_103a entries is tracked in #7043.
- **Exporter side.** These packages are written by the exporter. Until the exporter learns the guard, regenerating them brings the old imports back.
- **The vendoring gate's AOT library load and smoke launch.** Both need compiled libraries and a GPU. The new test stops at the host-side `ValueError`s.

```experimental-tests

tests/experimental/test_cake_moe_grouped_gemm_api.py
tests/experimental/test_cake_moe_grouped_gemm_standalone.py
```

Closes #7047

+# gate sets it -- still imports.

+# the same warning text with the same attributes, ``stacklevel`` and once-only
+# rule as FlashInfer's helpers; they do no API logging, read no environment
+# variable, and their category is the ``ExperimentalWarning`` below (a
+# ``UserWarning``), not FlashInfer's class.

+
+    Emitted once per experimental function on first use and once per
+    (stable API, backend) pair.  Inside FlashInfer the warnings carry
+    ``flashinfer.api_logging.ExperimentalWarning`` instead.
+    """
+
+
+def _core_helpers() -> Optional[tuple[Any, Any]]:
+    """FlashInfer's two helpers as a pair, or ``None`` when they cannot be imported."""
+    try:
+        from flashinfer.api_logging import (
+            flashinfer_experimental_api,
+            warn_experimental_backend_once,
+        )
+    except ImportError:  # no importable FlashInfer, or one without these helpers
+        return None
+    return flashinfer_experimental_api, warn_experimental_backend_once
+
+
+def _standalone_experimental_api(
+    func: Optional[Callable] = None, *, feature: Optional[str] = None
+) -> Callable:
+    """Stand-in for ``flashinfer.api_logging.flashinfer_experimental_api``.
+
+    Marks ``f`` and the returned wrapper ``is_experimental``, records
+    ``experimental_feature``, prepends the docstring banner and emits one
+    :class:`ExperimentalWarning` on the first call.  No API logging; the
+    ``trace`` keyword of FlashInfer's decorator is not taken (no call site in
+    this package passes it).

+        f.is_experimental = True  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+        feature_name = feature if feature is not None else f.__qualname__
+        warned = False
+
+        @functools.wraps(f)
+        def wrapper(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
+            nonlocal warned
+            if not warned:
+                warned = True
+                warnings.warn(
+                    f"'{feature_name}' is an experimental FlashInfer API: it "
+                    f"provides no compatibility guarantees and may change or be "
+                    f"removed without deprecation.",
+                    ExperimentalWarning,
+                    stacklevel=2,
+                )
+            return f(*args, **kwargs)
+

+        wrapper.experimental_feature = feature_name  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+        banner = (

+            f"    ``{feature_name}`` is experimental: it provides no "
+            f"compatibility guarantees and may change or be removed without "
+            f"deprecation."
+        )

+
+
+def _standalone_warn_backend_once(
+    api_name: str, backend: str, *, automatic: bool = False
+) -> None:
+    """Stand-in for ``flashinfer.api_logging.warn_experimental_backend_once``.
+
+    Emits :class:`ExperimentalWarning` once per ``(api_name, backend)`` pair,
+    attributed to the caller of the stable API (``stacklevel=3``).  The set of
+    warned pairs is this module's, so a second copy of the package in the same
+    process keeps its own.
+    """
+    key = (api_name, backend)
+    if key in _WARNED_BACKENDS:
+        return
+    _WARNED_BACKENDS.add(key)

+        f"compatibility guarantees and may change or be removed without "
+        f"deprecation.",

+        stacklevel=3,
+    )
+
+
+_CORE = _core_helpers()

+STANDALONE = _CORE is None
+flashinfer_experimental_api = (

+warn_experimental_backend_once = (
+    _CORE[1] if _CORE is not None else _standalone_warn_backend_once

+    )
+    with pytest.warns(api_logging.ExperimentalWarning, match="probe"):
+        probe()
+
+    for name in API_NAMES:
+        fn = getattr(pkg, name)
+        assert fn.is_experimental is True, name
+        assert fn.__wrapped__.is_experimental is True, name
+        assert fn.experimental_feature == f"cake_moe_grouped_gemm.{name}", name
+        assert fn.__doc__.startswith(".. warning::"), name
+        # A fresh wrapper of the real function: its once-only warning is
+        # observable whatever ran earlier in this process.
+        fresh = ex.flashinfer_experimental_api(feature=fn.experimental_feature)(
+            fn.__wrapped__
+        )
+        [w] = _experimental_warnings_of(lambda: fresh(*_host_args(name)))
+        assert w.category is api_logging.ExperimentalWarning, (name, w.category)
+        assert fn.experimental_feature in str(w.message), str(w.message)
+        assert _experimental_warnings_of(lambda: fresh(*_host_args(name))) == [], name
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(api_logging, "_WARNED_EXPERIMENTAL_BACKENDS", set())
+    m_indptr = torch.tensor([0, 2, 4], dtype=torch.int32)
+    backend_call = lambda: cb.grouped_mm_bf16_cake(
+        _f32(4, 64), _f32(2, 256, 64), m_indptr, out_dtype=torch.float32
+    )
+    [w] = _experimental_warnings_of(backend_call)
+    assert w.category is api_logging.ExperimentalWarning, w.category
+    assert "experimental backend 'cake' selected for 'grouped_mm_bf16'" in str(
+        w.message
+    )
+    assert ("grouped_mm_bf16", "cake") in api_logging._WARNED_EXPERIMENTAL_BACKENDS
+    assert not ex._WARNED_BACKENDS
+    assert _experimental_warnings_of(backend_call) == []
+
+
+def test_stand_ins_match_the_core_helpers(monkeypatch):
+    """The stand-ins reproduce FlashInfer's helpers: the same docstring banner,
+    attributes, signature, warning text, category name and attribution
+    (``stacklevel``), and the same once-only rule.  A wording change in
+    ``flashinfer.api_logging`` fails here until the stand-ins follow."""
+
+    def core_fn(x, *, y=1):
+        """Throwaway."""
+        return (x, y)
+
+    def standin_fn(x, *, y=1):
+        """Throwaway."""
+        return (x, y)
+
+    def raw(x):
+        return x
+
+    core = api_logging.flashinfer_experimental_api(feature="f")(core_fn)
+    standin = ex._standalone_experimental_api(feature="f")(standin_fn)
+    assert core.__doc__ == standin.__doc__
+    assert core.experimental_feature == standin.experimental_feature == "f"
+    assert core.is_experimental is True and standin.is_experimental is True
+    assert core.__wrapped__.is_experimental is True
+    assert standin.__wrapped__.is_experimental is True
+    assert inspect.signature(core) == inspect.signature(standin)
+    # Without feature= both fall back to the function's qualified name.
+    assert (
+        api_logging.flashinfer_experimental_api(raw).experimental_feature
+        == ex._standalone_experimental_api(raw).experimental_feature
+    )
+
+    a, b = _recorded(core, 1, y=2), _recorded(standin, 1, y=2)
+    assert str(a.message) == str(b.message)
+    assert a.category.__name__ == b.category.__name__ == "ExperimentalWarning"
+    assert a.category is api_logging.ExperimentalWarning
+    assert b.category is ex.ExperimentalWarning
+    assert (a.filename, a.lineno) == (b.filename, b.lineno)  # same stacklevel
+    assert Path(a.filename).name == Path(__file__).name
+    with warnings.catch_warnings():
+        warnings.simplefilter("error", api_logging.ExperimentalWarning)
+        warnings.simplefilter("error", ex.ExperimentalWarning)
+        assert core(1) == standin(1) == (1, 1)  # second call: silent
+
+    assert inspect.signature(
+        ex._standalone_warn_backend_once, eval_str=True
+    ) == inspect.signature(api_logging.warn_experimental_backend_once, eval_str=True)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(api_logging, "_WARNED_EXPERIMENTAL_BACKENDS", set())
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ex, "_WARNED_BACKENDS", set())
+    for automatic in (False, True):
+        backend = "auto_backend" if automatic else "backend"
+        a = _recorded(
+            api_logging.warn_experimental_backend_once,
+            "api",
+            backend,
+            automatic=automatic,
+        )
+        b = _recorded(
+            ex._standalone_warn_backend_once, "api", backend, automatic=automatic
+        )
+        assert str(a.message) == str(b.message)
+        assert a.category.__name__ == b.category.__name__ == "ExperimentalWarning"
+        assert a.category is api_logging.ExperimentalWarning
+        assert b.category is ex.ExperimentalWarning
+        assert (a.filename, a.lineno) == (b.filename, b.lineno)  # same stacklevel
+        assert Path(a.filename).name == Path(__file__).name
+    with warnings.catch_warnings():
+        warnings.simplefilter("error", api_logging.ExperimentalWarning)
+        warnings.simplefilter("error", ex.ExperimentalWarning)
+        api_logging.warn_experimental_backend_once("api", "backend")
+        ex._standalone_warn_backend_once("api", "backend")
+    expected = {("api", "backend"), ("api", "auto_backend")}
+    assert expected == api_logging._WARNED_EXPERIMENTAL_BACKENDS
+    assert expected == ex._WARNED_BACKENDS
